manifest.name: @huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui
manifest.description: dsh-tianshu-tui: an interactive terminal UI plugin for the official DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown/tool cards, 16+ themes, slash commands, session tabs, LSP diagnostics, cost tracking, self-update (`dsh plugin --profile tui add @huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui`)

scripts.lint: oxlint src tests scripts vision-ask/src vision-ask/tests

bundle.text:
# The dsh-tianshu-tui bundle patch: mounts the interactive terminal UI over
# dsh-base and moves the agent plane behind official agent presets (same split
# as dsh-web-app). Host keeps registries, sandbox, approval, and model routing.
# The runner hosts the ported render core and TuiApp (SOURCE-MAP.md / README.md).
#
# 0.2.0：官方 `dsh-agent-presets`（文件根花名册）退场，改为
# `dsh-agent-preset-registry`（声明注册表）+ 每预设一条 `dsh-agent-preset`
# 声明行（声明式插件列表）。`agentPresets` 服务名与 mount/composeFrom/recompose
# 接缝不变（preset-join.ts 的鸭式面继续命中）。预设声明与官方 web-app 0.2.1-rc.4
# presets/*.patch.yml 对齐；schedule 行按下方宿主约束裁剪。

- insert:
    - id: tui-runner
      name: '@huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui'

    # rc.1 起 standard preset 的 tool-subagent 行开 modelSelectionSettings: true，
    # 要求 Host scope 有 model-selection-settings 服务（官方 web-app 有、dsh-base
    # 无）——不挂则 standard 挂载整体失败、会话无工具面。shipped 组成默认关。
    - id: subagent-model-selection-settings
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings'

    - id: cordis-host-runner
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-host-runner'

    # Process-global inspect providers read by the cordis preset's tool-cordis row.
    - id: cordis-inspect-providers
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis/host'

    # 0.2.1 的 schedule 工具依赖 Web sessionController；base TUI 不挂该服务，
    # 因此 standard/ptc/cordis 不同步 schedule 行，避免 Loader 永久 pending。

    # LSP 模型工具面（任务6对齐，2026-08-27）：tianshu-public 三件套——
    # seam（ctx.lsp 注册表）+ stdio 本地 provider + 模型工具（单 lsp 工具四操作：
    # goToDefinition / findReferences / goToImplementation / hover）。lsp-local
    # 默认给 typescript-language-server 一个 npx 条目（懒启动；npx 随 node 在场，
    # 加载期解析不炸，首次查询按需拉取）；其他语言由用户照此追加 servers 条目。
    # 无 provider 时模型查询收到结构化 LSP_UNAVAILABLE（schema 稳定）。
    - id: lsp
      name: '@huiliyi37/dsh-lsp'

    - id: lsp-local
      name: '@huiliyi37/dsh-lsp-local'
      config:
        servers:
          typescript:
            command: npx
            args: ['-y', 'typescript-language-server', '--stdio']
            extensionToLanguage:
              .ts: typescript
              .tsx: typescript
              .js: javascript
              .jsx: javascript
              .mjs: javascript
              .cjs: javascript

    - id: tool-lsp
      name: '@huiliyi37/dsh-tool-lsp'

    # The preset selection registry（对标 web-app 0.2.1 cordis.patch.yml 尾行）。
    - id: agent-preset-registry
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry'
      config:
        default: standard

    # ── shipped 预设声明（与官方 web-app 0.2.1-rc.4 presets/ 对齐，schedule 除外）

    - id: preset-standard
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: standard
        order: 1
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:

                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control

              - id: tool-subagent-list-agents
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelectionSettings: true
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: true
          - id: tool-plugin-market
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market/tools'
            disabled: true

          - id: persistent-shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:

            config:
              - id: pty
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal'
              - id: terminal-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 300000
              - id: persistent-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash-persistent'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 300000
                  description: |-
                    Run commands in a bash shell
                    * When invoking this tool, the contents of the "command" parameter does NOT need to be XML-escaped.
                    * Network access depends on the task environment. Prefer configured mirrors/proxies when they are available.
                    * State is persistent across command calls and discussions with the user.
                    * To inspect a particular line range of a file, e.g. lines 10-25, try 'sed -n 10,25p /path/to/the/file'.
                    * Please avoid commands that may produce a very large amount of output.
                    * Please run long lived commands in the background, e.g. 'sleep 10 &' or start a server in the background.
              - id: terminal-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  shellDialect: pwsh
                  timeoutMs: 300000
              - id: persistent-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 300000
                  description: |-
                    Run commands in a PowerShell shell
                    * When invoking this tool, the contents of the "command" parameter does NOT need to be XML-escaped.
                    * You don't have access to the internet via this tool.
                    * State is persistent across command calls and discussions with the user.
                    * Use native Windows paths (C:\...) and $env:NAME variables; this is PowerShell, not bash.
                    * Please avoid commands that may produce a very large amount of output.
                    * Please run long lived commands in the background, e.g. 'Start-Job' or start a server with Start-Process.

中文 · [English](README.en.md)

`dsh-tianshu-tui` 是官方 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的交互式终端 UI 插件。自研轻量 ANSI 渲染引擎，提供流式 Markdown、工具卡、会话恢复与回退、图片与视觉桥、LSP 诊断、16 个主题，以及完整的 slash 命令和快捷键体系。

它是一个**纯展示层插件**：agent 状态来自会话事件流，不另建一套 agent 循环，也不向模型偷偷注入 prompt 或工具。

| 能力 | 你可以做什么 |
|---|---|
| **流畅对话与工具视图** | 流式 Markdown、推理过程折叠、并行工具分组、结构化 diff、回合耗时与 token 指标 |
| **完整会话工作区** | 恢复、切换、分叉、回退、导出会话；运行中排队，或通过 `/steer` 即时纠偏 |
| **高效输入** | slash 菜单、`@` 路径补全、历史搜索、多行粘贴、外部编辑器，以及可选 Vim 键位 |
| **图片与视觉** | 粘贴并内联预览图片；识图模型直接接收，文本模型可经视觉桥获得图片描述 |
| **Agent 控制面板** | 审批 diff、plan 模式、目标、任务、技能、子代理与 workflow 状态集中呈现 |
| **可定制的开发环境** | 16 个主题、LSP 诊断、项目记忆、MCP 浏览、模型与推理等级热切换 |

| 组件 | 当前验证版本 |
|---|---|
| Node.js | `^22.19 || >=24` |
| 包管理器 | [`pnpm`](https://pnpm.io/installation)，可由 `corepack enable` 启用 |
| DeepSeek Harness | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.4`，即 npm `next` 通道 |
| 本插件 | `@huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui@1.0.0-rc.4` |

> **请显式使用宿主 `@next`。** 不要用宿主 `@latest` 代替（当前为 `0.2.1-rc.2`，低于要求）；`@alpha` 的 `0.2.2-alpha.2` 存在已知 API 不兼容，暂不支持。本包也不是可独立运行的 CLI。

脚本会检查 Node/pnpm、安装官方 CLI、装配插件并启动：

```sh

bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui/main/scripts/install-tui.sh)
```

```powershell

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui/main/scripts/install-tui.ps1 | iex"
```

只安装、不启动：macOS/Linux 在命令末尾加 `--no-launch`；Windows 克隆仓库后运行 `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-tui.ps1 -NoLaunch`。
```sh

readme.section: 1. 将插件装入独立的 tui profile
readme.text: pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@next plugin --profile tui add @huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui

pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@next --profile tui
```

首次启动后按引导配置 API Key，或输入 `/key`。看到 **dsh-tianshu-tui** 欢迎页即安装成功；按 `Ctrl+Q` 或输入 `/exit` 退出。

> 如果旧全局 `dsh` 导致 `ERR_FS_EISDIR`，或 npm 11 安装大型依赖树时发生 OOM，请改用上面的 `pnpm dlx` 命令。更多安装与排障方式见[快速开始文档](docs/getting-started.md)。

| 命令 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/session` | 新建、列出、切换或恢复会话 |
| `/fork` · `/rewind` | 分叉探索，或回退到历史消息边界 |
| `/model` · `/effort` | 切换当前会话的模型与推理等级 |
| `/preset` | 查看或切换 standard / PTC / minimal / creative 预设 |
| `/status` · `/tasks` · `/subagents` | 查看目标、任务与子代理状态 |
| `/theme` · `/density` | 切换主题与紧凑渲染 |
| `/scroll` · `/export` | 浏览完整转录，或导出 Markdown |

| 按键 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `Enter` | 发送 |
| `Shift+Enter` | 换行（或 `\`+Enter 续行） |
| `Ctrl+N` | 新会话 |
| `Ctrl+S` | 恢复最近会话 |
| `Ctrl+Q` | 退出（同 `/exit`） |
| `Ctrl+P` | 命令面板 |
| `Ctrl+.` | 完整键位表 |
| `Ctrl+F` / `Ctrl+R` | 历史搜索；`n`/`N` 下一个，`p`/`P` 上一个 |
| `Ctrl+O` | 展开/收起最近推理块 |
| `Ctrl+E` | 用 `$EDITOR` 编辑输入行 |
| `Ctrl+T` | 中轮转向 |
| `Ctrl+Enter` | 打断当前回合并立即发送草稿（需 kitty 键盘协议） |
| `Ctrl+C` | 打断在途回合；空闲空输入时双击退出 |
| `Ctrl+V` | 粘贴剪贴板图片，无图时粘贴文本 |
| `Alt+W` | 经 OSC52 把选区复制到系统剪贴板 |
| `Shift+Tab` | 循环 normal → plan → always-approve |
| `Tab` | `@` 路径补全；接受 slash 菜单选中项 |
| `Ctrl+U` | 删除到行首 |
| `↑`/`↓` | 输入历史；菜单打开时为选择；空输入 ↑ 取回排队消息 |
| `PageUp`/`PageDown` | slash 菜单翻页 |
| `Esc` | 关闭面板或取消提问；空闲双击打开 rewind |
| `t` | 审批卡：本会话内记住此工具 |
| `a` | 审批卡：本会话放行 |
完整命令、审批操作、Vim 键位和终端协议说明见[交互手册](docs/interaction.md)。

从 npm 安装的插件会在启动时检查更新；也可以在 TUI 中输入 `/update` 手动检查。设置 `DSH_TUI_SKIP_UPDATE=1` 可关闭启动检查。

```sh
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@next plugin --profile tui add @huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui
```

当前版本：**[`1.0.0-rc.4`](https://github.com/huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui/releases/tag/v1.0.0-rc.4)**，适配宿主 `0.2.1-rc.4`。本版修复 [#61](https://github.com/huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui/issues/61)：WSL/原生粘贴 API Key、供应商目录与账号入口，并新增自定义 pi-ai 端点、模型发现和已有路由编辑。版本历史见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)，TUI 内可输入 `/changelog` 查看。

- **事件驱动**：所有渲染状态派生自会话事件流，恢复与实时显示走同一套转录桥。
- **不越过展示层边界**：不注册自有 prompt、工具或上下文面，不直接改写 agent 请求体。
- **明确降级**：宿主可选服务缺失时，对应面板会说明原因，不静默空白，也不阻塞启动。
- **终端友好**：支持窄屏、16 色与 `NO_COLOR`，并针对中文宽字符、长输出和流式刷新优化。

实现细节与边界约束见[架构文档](docs/architecture.md)和 [ADAPTER.md](ADAPTER.md)。

- `ask_image` 图片再询问需要同仓伴生插件 [`vision-ask`](vision-ask/README.md)；基础图片提交与视觉桥不依赖它。
- LSP server 采用懒启动；大型仓库可能常驻较多内存，切换会话时 `rootUri` 仍沿用首个会话目录。
- 上游 schedule 依赖 Web `sessionController`，当前 TUI 未挂载该工具面。
- `0.2.2-alpha.2` 的模型选择与预设 API 已发生变化，完成专项适配前请停留在宿主 `0.2.1-rc.4`。

[中文](README.md) · English

`dsh-tianshu-tui` is an interactive terminal UI plugin for the official [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Its lightweight, purpose-built ANSI renderer delivers streaming Markdown, tool cards, session restore and rewind, image and vision bridging, LSP diagnostics, 16 themes, and a complete slash-command and keyboard interface.
It is a **presentation-only plugin**: agent state comes from the session event stream. It does not run a second agent loop or silently inject its own prompts or tools.

| Capability | What it enables |
|---|---|
| **Fluid conversations and tool views** | Streaming Markdown, collapsible reasoning, grouped parallel tools, structured diffs, turn timing, and token metrics |
| **A complete session workspace** | Restore, switch, fork, rewind, and export sessions; queue messages while running or steer the active turn |
| **Efficient input** | Slash menu, `@` path completion, history search, multi-line paste, external editor, and optional Vim keybindings |
| **Images and vision** | Paste and preview images inline; vision models receive them directly, while text-only models can use a vision bridge |
| **Agent control panels** | Approval diffs, plan mode, goals, tasks, skills, subagents, and workflow state in one place |
| **A customizable development environment** | 16 themes, LSP diagnostics, project memory, MCP browsing, and live model/reasoning-effort switching |

| Component | Currently validated version |
|---|---|
| Node.js | `^22.19 || >=24` |
| Package manager | [`pnpm`](https://pnpm.io/installation), available through `corepack enable` |
| DeepSeek Harness | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.4`, published on the npm `next` channel |
| This plugin | `@huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui@1.0.0-rc.4` |

> **Use the host `@next` tag explicitly.** Do not substitute the host `@latest` tag (currently `0.2.1-rc.2`, below the required version). The `@alpha` release `0.2.2-alpha.2` has known API incompatibilities and is not supported yet. This package is not a standalone CLI.

The installer checks Node/pnpm, installs the official CLI, wires the plugin, and launches it:

```sh

bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui/main/scripts/install-tui.sh)
```

```powershell

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui/main/scripts/install-tui.ps1 | iex"
```

To install without launching, append `--no-launch` on macOS/Linux. On Windows, clone the repository and run `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-tui.ps1 -NoLaunch`.
```sh

pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@next --profile tui
```

Follow the first-run guide to configure an API key, or enter `/key`. The **dsh-tianshu-tui** welcome screen confirms a successful install. Quit with `Ctrl+Q` or `/exit`.

npm installs check for updates at startup. You can also run `/update` inside the TUI. Set `DSH_TUI_SKIP_UPDATE=1` to disable the startup check.

```sh
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@next plugin --profile tui add @huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui
```

Current release: **[`1.0.0-rc.4`](https://github.com/huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui/releases/tag/v1.0.0-rc.4)**, adapted to host `0.2.1-rc.4`. This release fixes [#61](https://github.com/huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui/issues/61): WSL/native API-key paste, provider directory and account entry behavior, plus custom pi-ai endpoints, model discovery, and existing-route editing. - **Event-driven**: all rendered state derives from session events; live rendering and restored transcripts share the same bridge.
- **Presentation boundaries**: no private prompt, tool, or context surfaces, and no direct mutation of agent request bodies.
- **Explicit degradation**: missing optional host services produce an actionable message instead of a blank panel or a startup failure.
- **Terminal-friendly**: supports narrow screens, 16-color terminals, and `NO_COLOR`, with handling for wide CJK text, long output, and streaming refreshes.
See the [architecture guide](docs/architecture.en.md) and [ADAPTER.md](ADAPTER.md) for implementation details and boundary constraints.

- Re-interrogating images with `ask_image` requires the companion [`vision-ask`](vision-ask/README.md) plugin; basic image submission and vision bridging do not.
- LSP servers start lazily but may remain resident in large repositories; `rootUri` follows the first session's working directory after a session switch.
- Upstream schedule depends on the Web `sessionController`, so this TUI does not mount that tool surface yet.
- Host `0.2.2-alpha.2` changes model-selection and preset APIs. Stay on host `0.2.1-rc.4` until dedicated adaptation work is complete.
